summary: Austin Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly report by a foreign private issuer, with no mention of any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The registrant's role is solely as the filer of the periodic report.
